content:
The voltmeter's accuracy is specified as 2% of full scale reading.  
Full scale = 100 V.  
So, maximum possible error in volts = \( 0.02 \times 100 = 2 \text{ V} \).  

Measured voltage = 75 V.  
Limiting error in percentage of the measured value =  
\[
\frac{2}{75} \times 100\% \approx 2.666\%
\]  

This matches option (B).  

Final answer: (B)
